changeSet.sql: IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT * FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.TABLES WHERE TABLE_SCHEMA = 'api' AND TABLE_NAME = 'ExecutionResponsibilityTypeRelationOverrideItem') BEGIN CREATE TABLE [api].[ExecutionResponsibilityTypeRelationOverrideItem]( [ExecutionID] [uniqueidentifier] NOT NULL, [ItemNumber] [int] NOT NULL, [ExecutionItemUid] [uniqueidentifier] NOT NULL, [ResponsibilityTypeUid] [uniqueidentifier] NOT NULL, [AssetUid] [uniqueidentifier] NOT NULL, [SecurityAssetUid] [uniqueidentifier] NOT NULL, [Context] [nvarchar](max) NULL, [Message] [nvarchar](max) NULL, [Success] [bit] NULL CONSTRAINT [PK_ExecutionResponsibilityTypeRelationOverrideItem] PRIMARY KEY CLUSTERED ( [ExecutionID] ASC, [ItemNumber] ASC )WITH (STATISTICS_NORECOMPUTE = OFF, IGNORE_DUP_KEY = OFF) ON [PRIMARY] ) ON [PRIMARY] END
